sequence_hint: Build a flow from connected actions. Numbered arrows show execution order; one cycle repeats the full flow. Up to 256 actions.
canvas_hint: Drag nodes to arrange the canvas. Connections keep the numbered execution order. Select a node to edit its action below.
canvas_drag: Drag to arrange · click to edit
canvas_select_hint: Select a node on the canvas or its step below to edit the action.
invalid_settings_file: The settings file is invalid or contains unsupported values.
invalid_language: The settings file refers to an unavailable language.
invalid_theme: The settings file uses an unsupported theme.
invalid_accent: Use a 6-digit HEX accent color, for example #6C8CFF.
invalid_hotkeys: The settings file contains invalid or duplicate start/stop hotkeys.
move_hint: Move the pointer to these screen coordinates.
key_hint: Single key or combination, e.g. Space, Enter, F6, Ctrl+A
accent_hint: Pick a swatch or open the color picker. Changes apply immediately and are saved automatically.
appearance_hint: Add a JSON translation file to the locales folder in the app config directory to add another language.
hotkey_hint: Examples: F6, Ctrl+F6. Hotkeys must be different.
about_text: A cross-platform mouse and keyboard automation tool. Python remains available in the repository; this Rust edition is a separate application.
interval_error: The cycle interval must be at least 1 ms.
empty_sequence_error: Add at least one enabled action to the sequence.
updating: Theme and accent changes apply immediately; automation changes take effect when you next start the sequence.
studio_mode_note: Visual workflow editor · drag nodes, connect ports, configure actions.
studio_canvas_hint: Drag nodes · click an output port, then a target node
studio_select_hint: Select a node on the canvas to inspect and edit its settings.
studio_click_target: Click to connect from the selected output
studio_drag_node: Drag to arrange · select to edit
studio_condition_note: Both condition outputs can be connected on the canvas.
studio_invalid_flow: This flow is incomplete or invalid. Review its connections and node properties.
studio_limit_reached: The workflow reached the maximum of 256 nodes.
studio_palette_help: Add at a single connected end path, or wire new nodes manually.
studio_separate_classic: Classic and Studio keep separate workflows. Changes in one editor do not update the other.
